## Evidence

## Medicines-data boundaries

- [ ] Regulatory, funding, formulary, price, procurement, and availability assertions remain separate
- [ ] Source authority, URL, licence/redistribution rights, valid time, observed time, and digest are recorded
- [ ] Missing or incomplete source data is not represented as a negative conclusion
- [ ] Generated data is reproducible and its provenance is retained
